name: alakazam_ml_v30
model: A two-layer imitation policy: lossless exact replay memory for known top-agent questions, followed by a 648-feature LightGBM LambdaRank residual policy for unseen single-choice MAIN decisions.
model_scope: Exact memory covers every recorded selection context. The learned residual policy covers unseen single-choice MAIN decisions. The frozen v29 policy remains the fallback for unsupported, nested, unsafe, low-confidence, or illegal cases.

teacher_training.label: One representative per card, attack, and target semantic option.

safety_guards: Always preserve a deterministic immediate lethal attack.
Do not replace a complete fallback Boss route with a non-Boss MAIN action.
Reject candidates that destroy a currently available KO.
Never end the turn while the Active Alakazam can attack.
Do not cycle Dudunsparce away from a board of two or fewer Pokemon.
Use the frozen v29 policy for unsupported, nested, low-confidence, low-time, or illegal cases.
known_limitations: The requested 90% unseen top-choice agreement was not reached: held-out semantic top-1 is 73.95%. Held-out top-3 recall is 95.11%.
The 100% semantic replay result measures exact questions already stored in teacher memory and is not an unbiased generalization estimate.
Exact/canonical memory retrieves only 1.66% of chronologically held-out decisions, so the learned ranker remains essential for genuinely unseen states.
Unseen Boss, retreat, trainer, Xerosic, and energy choices remain the weakest action families.
Local arena results are opponent- and seed-dependent. A real leaderboard submission is required to determine whether v30 improves the approximately 800 rating.
